name: Marokko-Phosphat
laenderpaar: Marokko ↔ EU und USA über Westsahara, Cadmium und Ausgleichszölle
hinweis: Denkhilfe, keine Anlageberatung. Rot setzt nur der Metall-Wächter in der Cloud.

gruende.titel: Request for Comments on the Effect of the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism and the Proposals To Expand Coverage on U.S. Trade

fristen.name: EU-Cadmiumgrenzwert von 60 mg/kg für Phosphatdünger (Verordnung 2019/1009)
fristen.stand: In Kraft; eine Absenkung des Grenzwerts würde marokkanisches Gestein stärker treffen als russisches. Überprüfung steht an.

fristen.name: US-Ausgleichszoll auf marokkanischen Phosphatdünger
fristen.stand: Seit 26.12.2024 bei 16,60 Prozent. Jede jährliche Überprüfung kann den Satz bewegen.

fristen.name: Geändertes EU-Marokko-Agrarabkommen mit Herkunftskennzeichnung für die Südprovinzen
fristen.stand: Seit 03.10.2025 vorläufig angewandt; betrifft Phosphat nur mittelbar, ist aber der Gradmesser für die Westsahara-Frage.

dokumente.titel: Certain Paper Shopping Bags From Malaysia: Preliminary Results, Preliminary Determination of No Shipments and Rescission, in Part, of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025
dokumente.zusammenfassung: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that Hexachase Packaging Sdn. Bhd. (Hexachase) made sales of subject merchandise at less than normal value (NV) during the period of review (POR), January 3, 2024, through June 30, 2025. Commerce also preliminarily determines that Sin Boon Beng Printing Sdn. Bhd. (SBBP), made no shipments during the POR. Finally, we are rescinding the review with respect to two companies. Interested parties are invited to comment on these preliminary results of review.

dokumente.titel: Certain Paper Shopping Bags From India: Preliminary Results and Rescission, in Part of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025
dokumente.zusammenfassung: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that Ckaari Packaging Private Limited (Ckaari) and Velvin Packaging Solution Private Limited, Velvin Paper Products, and the Velvin Group (collectively, Velvin) made sales of certain paper shopping bags (paper bags) from India at less than normal value (NV) during the period of review (POR), January 3, 2024, through June 30, 2025. In addition, we are rescinding the review, in part, with respect to seven companies. Interested parties are invited to comment on these preliminary results of review.

dokumente.titel: Certain Potassium Phosphate Salts From the People's Republic of China: Final Results of the Expedited Third Sunset Review of the Countervailing Duty Order
dokumente.zusammenfassung: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) finds that revocation of the countervailing duty (CVD) order on certain potassium phosphate salts (phosphate salts) from the People's Republic of China (China) would be likely to lead to continuation or recurrence of countervailable subsidies at the levels indicated in the "Final Results of Sunset Review" section of this notice.

dokumente.titel: Potassium Phosphate Salts From the People's Republic of China: Final Results of the Expedited Third Sunset Review of the Antidumping Duty Order
dokumente.zusammenfassung: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) finds that revocation of the antidumping duty (AD) order on certain potassium phosphate salts (salts) from the People's Republic of China (China) would be likely to lead to continuation or recurrence of dumping, at the levels indicated in the "Final Results of Sunset Review" section of this notice.
